resources.string: Scan the code with your phone, then choose a picture for %1$s.
Use the arrows to move it, then press OK
This build has a different signing key: update it from a computer, with build-and-install.sh
Allow Vibe Launcher to install apps, then choose Update again
This device doesn\'t let apps install updates
The download didn\'t match the release, so it wasn\'t installed
Clean backdrops and title logos for films and shows.
Popular videos in your country for the YouTube tile.
Your own YouTube feed for the YouTube tile, no key needed.
Backdrops from your own Plex server.
Started as a fork of Gathin23/tv-vibehack. The Outfit typeface is under the SIL Open Font License. Backdrops use the TMDB API but are not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Scan with your phone to paste the keys
Backdrops use the TMDB API but are not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Clean backdrops and title logos for the films and shows on your apps\' home screen cards, in place of their own art and stickers. It works without a key, from Stremio\'s free data; TMDB is the official, more reliable source.\n\nFree key: themoviedb.org → Settings → API → personal use.

With SmartTube signed in, the YouTube tile shows videos from your own YouTube feed. No key needed.

Without it, a key shows the most popular videos in your country. Free key: console.cloud.google.com → new project → enable YouTube Data API v3 → Credentials → Create API key.

With neither, it shows trailers of popular films.
SmartTube installs through Downloader (by AFTVnews): get Downloader from the Play Store, open it and type %s.

Backdrops from your own Plex server: Continue Watching and recently added.\n\nTo find it: app.plex.tv → open any title → ⋯ → Get Info → View XML, and copy what follows X-Plex-Token= in the address. Keep it private, like a password.
This device doesn\'t have that settings screen. Look for it in the device\'s own Settings.
Where backdrops and title logos for films and shows come from, and which is tried first.
OK goes from Enabled to ↕ (Up and Down move it) to Disabled. Right also enables or disables. Back or Left puts a moving source down and keeps it enabled.
Background poster lookup order, only the first match is used
TMDB\'s backdrops and logos, found by the card\'s title. Needs a TMDB key (API keys).
For apps that put the title\'s IMDb id on their cards, like Nuvio: the exact backdrop and logo, no key needed.
Stremio\'s free film and show data, found by the card\'s title. No key needed.
The picture the app put on its card, when nothing above has one.
See your wallpapers as pictures and delete the ones you don\'t want.
Your own pictures and videos behind Home: where an app has no picture, or instead of every backdrop.
Off; only where an app has no picture of its own (instead of its plain colour); or always, instead of every backdrop.
Send a picture (framed on the phone) or a video of up to 500 MB from your phone.
Scan with your phone to send a picture or a video
Free from pexels.com/api: lets you pick Pexels videos as custom wallpapers (Backdrops).
Pexels needs a free API key first: get one at pexels.com/api and add it in Settings > API keys.
Pictures from wallhaven.cc, safe for work only.
Type what you\'re looking for, then Done
Couldn\'t reach %s. Check the internet connection.
That one couldn\'t be downloaded. Try another.
Pictures and videos from NASA\'s Image and Video Library
Pictures and videos from Wikimedia Commons, each under its own licence
Free at pixabay.com/api/docs once you sign up: lets you pick Pixabay pictures and videos as custom wallpapers (Backdrops).
Pixabay needs a free API key first: sign up at pixabay.com, copy your key from pixabay.com/api/docs and add it in Settings > API keys.
The weather under the date on Home, for the location set here.
What the weather line under the date shows. Its icon is always there.
Automatic finds the device\'s city from its internet address. Or search for a city and pick it.
Couldn\'t search for cities. Check the internet connection and try again.
The full bar, or minimal icons over the background; and the clock, date and weather in it.
Minimal: no bar, just small icons at the top right and the time and weather at the top left, over the background, always showing.
Full: a frosted bar across the top with the large clock, the date and the weather, and buttons with their names.
Shown in the full top bar only.
The arrows move the dot: the color around the wheel, paler towards the middle. OK when done.
Channel Up and Down do nothing while Home is showing, instead of opening the device\'s own TV app.
The device restarts now. It takes about a minute to come back.
Makes the remote\'s Home button open Vibe Launcher instead of the stock launcher, and holding it open the device\'s Settings. It reads nothing on screen and passes every other key on.

This device doesn't let ADB be turned on, so Vibe Launcher needs an accessibility service to answer the Home button.

It takes the Home button: a press opens Vibe Launcher, a hold opens Settings, and every other key passes on untouched. It also sees when the stock launcher comes up, and covers it. It reads nothing on screen, keeps nothing and sends nothing anywhere.

Turn it off any time in Settings > Accessibility.

If you turn on “%1$s”, it also opens Vibe Launcher when the screen turns on, unless you press a key first (it notes only that a key was pressed, not which). And “%2$s” in Settings uses it to open the device\'s power menu.
Using ADB to set the Home button is recommended when it\'s available. The accessibility feature is for devices where ADB can\'t be turned on.
Using ADB to set the Home button is recommended when it\'s available. The accessibility feature is for devices where ADB can\'t be turned on.
ADB works on this device now. Make Vibe Launcher your Home through ADB and turn off the accessibility Home button? Cancel keeps everything as it is.
Vibe Launcher has connected to ADB on this device before, so it\'s probably just switched off. Turn debugging back on in Developer options.
Next: in the list that opens, choose “%1$s”, turn it on, then press Home.
Next: this device has no direct way to its Accessibility settings, so Android\'s Settings open instead. There, go to Device Preferences > Accessibility, choose “%1$s”, turn it on, then press Home.

Vibe Launcher will ask for two permissions next.

TV listings: to show pictures from the cards your apps publish for the home screen.

Location: Android only shows the Wi-Fi network's name to apps with it. Vibe Launcher uses it for that name alone and never looks up where the device is.

Neither leaves the device.
Settings, tiles, folders, tile pictures and API keys. A backup holds your keys, so keep it private.
Kept in the device\'s Download folder as vibe-launcher-backup.json, replacing the last one.
Back up or restore with your phone
Scan with your phone to save a backup there or send one back
Settings, tiles, folders and keys are all replaced by the backup\'s, then Home starts again.
Vibe Launcher needs storage access for this
Turn off apps you don\'t use: they stay installed, but can\'t run, fill the home screen or update until you turn them back on. Parts the device needs to work aren\'t listed.
Vibe Launcher turns apps off through the device\'s own ADB, as a computer would. Open this to see what\'s on and to connect.
The device will ask to allow Vibe Launcher: check Always allow, then OK.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging (called ADB debugging or Network debugging on some devices), then come back here.

Debugging is on, but this device doesn\'t let apps reach it yet. In Developer options, look for Network debugging or ADB over network and turn it on. If it only has Wireless debugging, Vibe Launcher can\'t use that yet.
Turns back on every app Vibe Launcher turned off.
This device can\'t keep the key Vibe Launcher needs
Your device needs this to work properly, so Vibe Launcher won\'t turn it off. This keeps your device safe.
Turn on Developer options first: in About, press OK on Build seven times, then come back here.
Scan with your phone, then type the code the device shows.
Scan with your phone, then open Developer options below: turn on Wireless debugging, open it, choose Pair device with pairing code, and type the code it shows on your phone.
Turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options, then come back here.

This device doesn\'t let apps reach its debugging over the network, and its Wireless debugging only works on Wi-Fi. Connect the device to Wi-Fi to pair Vibe Launcher, or look in Developer options for Network debugging.
Vibe Launcher already has ADB access, so this isn\'t needed. Continue anyway?
On but not running. Turn it off and on in Developer options.
Press OK to connect. Check Always allow when the device asks.
Unlock in About: press OK on Build 7 times.
The debugging switch in Developer options. Opens port 5555 on most devices.
This player\'s own switch in Developer options: opens port 5555 to the network, apart from USB debugging.
In Developer options, turn on Network debugging, then come back here.
Debugging over Wi-Fi (Android 11+). Used when port 5555 is closed.
Apps Vibe Launcher turned off before that an update has turned back on.
Tested lists of what to turn off, device by device, from the Clean Your TV community. Pick the one for your device, check it, then turn them off.
Lists by the Clean Your TV community (github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv), MIT licence, each tested on its device by the person who made it. The best matches for this device come first.
The lists couldn\'t be loaded. Check the device\'s internet connection.
✓ marks what will be turned off; OK changes it. Apps that aren\'t on this device are left out, and so are parts it needs. What the list\'s maker kept on by choice starts unticked.
When you leave Settings, Vibe Launcher turns the device\'s debugging off again, and back on by itself the next time it needs it. A computer can\'t reach the device over ADB while it\'s off.
Turns the stock launcher off, so the Home button opens Vibe Launcher.
The stock launcher is turned off and Vibe Launcher becomes Home. If that doesn\'t take, everything is put back at once. Choosing Stock launcher undoes it.
This device didn\'t take it, so the stock launcher is back
On this device, a different Home stops casting from working, so Vibe Launcher leaves the stock launcher alone.
The device\'s own animations, as apps and menus open: faster ones make an older device feel quicker. Needs Settings > Advanced to have been allowed once.
